memo: First GPU submission of the class-3 generator (e2gpu-1 was rejected by the weekly GPU quota and used no slot). Base: public 0.420 notebook (huseyinemreaksoy casmi26-v4n-fusion, Apache-2.0, and what it credits). Ours: MMP generator mined from train (up to 100 products), two-step MMP (20 intermediates), 10 FP-retrieved parents; after the 10-09 audit, an MMP exception falls back to the base list and MMP stops after 100 min. Class-3 val through ICE/GLACIER fusion (e2c3ice-2, 119 mols): MRR@25 0.2766 with MMP rows vs 0.0987 without; in-pool harm none (e2keep-1). The CPU versions (0.378/0.381) lacked ICEBERG; this one keeps ICEBERG/GLACIER on the GPU as the base does. Hypothesis: LB > 0.420.
message: e2gpu-2: base 0.420 + MMP 100 / 2-step 20 / FP parents 10, GPU, MMP fallback + time gate
